title: Activation Energy
coreMove: Design for the ignition threshold, not just the easier path after a change is already moving.
sourcePressure: Activation Energy explains why starting can require a threshold that continuing does not, so triggers and startup barriers matter.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: telling readers to want the goal more or to start small in a generic way
